defs.def: detailed information on how to do or use sth 用法说明；操作指南

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现，这样做让我的教学更有活力，让学生更投入，也向他们展示了抽象概念在现实世界中的实际运用。

ex.s: Students often attend classes in which they are not enrolled on the first day of instruction to try adding this new course to the list, as other students may have dropped it.
ex.t: 学生常在开课第一天去上他们未注册的课程，试图把这门新课加入列表，因为其他学生可能已退课。

ex.s: To give an instruction of drawing a budget Line.
ex.t: 你能看的电影的最大数量是10部。

ex.s: Results … Note: Do the experiment under the instructions of a teacher.
ex.t: 结果……注意：在老师的指导下进行实验。

ex.s: The instructions in the recipe are really (confuse) and I really need your help.
ex.t: 食谱上的说明真的很令人困惑，我真的需要你的帮助。
对其详细的说明印象深刻。

ex.s: Directions: Write an English composition in 120-150 words according to the instructions given below in Chinese.
ex.t: 说明：根据以下中文提示写一篇120-150词的英语作文。

ex.s: If you enjoy cooking, for example, you may faithfully follow a recipe without questioning the instructions.
ex.t: 例如，如果你喜欢烹饪，你可能会忠实地遵循食谱，而不质疑其中的说明。

defs.def: something that sb tells you to do 指示；命令；吩咐

ex.s: As you listen, make notes of key information such as names, numbers, facts and instructions.
ex.t: 听的时候，把关键信息记下来，比如姓名、数字、事实和指示。

ex.s: Choose a disaster and prepare a list of safety instructions.
ex.t: 选择一种灾难并准备一份安全指示清单。

ex.s: Giving instructions Tsunami Hits Asia: Over 6,500 Dead By Robert Woodhouse Monday, 27 December 2004 2 Read the summary of the news report.
ex.t: 发出指示：海啸袭击亚洲——超过6500人死亡。阅读新闻报告的摘要。

ex.s: •Meet outside of your residence hall and wait for further instructions．
ex.t: •不要以任何方式遮挡或堵塞你的烟雾探测器。

ex.s: wait for instructions in the hall
ex.t: B．不负责任的使用会损坏灭火器。

defs.def: a piece of information that tells a computer to perform a particular operation. （计算机的）指令

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

defs.def: the act of teaching sth to sb 教授；教导；传授
